The Garden area of the Rift has 3 sections. Near the bottom is a Desert section, then towards the upper left is a Garden section and towards the right is a Jungle section. The Ant Hell area has 3 sections, where the bottom left is the Fire part, while the top middle part is the Normal part and the top right part is the Termite part.
The rest of the areas have a normal section.

This usually happens when the petal possesses a high enough Health or Armor to survive or negate the damage received, or Evasion (i.e., Chip) to evade damage instances. It may also be loosely defined as the ability of a petal to hit two or more entities.

It may also be loosely defined as the ability of a petal to hit two or more entities.

This is useful in creating a defensive trail or shield.

Talents are a game mechanic in florr.io that allows the player to unlock powerful perks and stat increases for their flower, in exchange for spending Talent Points (TP). The player can obtain Talent Points by leveling up.

Main article: Level
Talent Points are obtained through leveling up. Defeating mobs or absorbing petals awards a certain amount of experience (XP) to the player. Each level has an XP threshold. When this threshold is passed, a specific amount of Talent Points are given to the player based on the level reached:
Levels ending in "5"
+2 TP
Levels ending in "0"
+10 TP

Health is an attribute that flowers have. It's used how many health the flower has, and if it runs out, the flower dies. At level 1, they have 200 max HP, and when they level up, they will slowly gain max HP and then will increase before stopping at level 100. They can also be increased by the Health talent by 1.3x per upgrade, or by petals such as Cactus, Relic and Soil.

The Magic Cotton is a petal in florr.io. It absorbs incoming damage dealt to the player (similar to the standard Cotton) at the cost of mana, with the amount of mana consumed being proportional to the amount of damage the player took. Magic Cotton is dropped by Bushes when the player has a Mana Orb equipped.

In this page, angle brackets < > are used to denote sections of syntax that the user needs to replace.
• The user should not include the angle brackets themselves when typing out the tag.

The syntax for a Rarity Tag is as follows:
[[r:<rarity>]]
The <rarity> term determines the rarity of the Tag.
• This term can be the name of a rarity itself, or a rarity number. Rarity numbers are zero-indexed, so "0" would be Common, "1" would be Unusual, and so on.
• Users opting to type the name of a rarity should always use the English name of the rarity.

The syntax for a Petal Tag is as follows:
[[p:<petal>:<rarity>]]

• This term can be the name of a petal itself, or a petal ID. Petal IDs are one-indexed, so "1" would be Basic, "2" would be Light, and so on.
• The user can obtain the petal ID of a petal by searching in https://florr.io/static/i18n/en_US/petals.txt.

For example all 3 zones in Ant Hell are heavily connected to the singular Soldier Ant, meaning that the drops of that one mob heavily outweight the drops of all the other mobs.

Main articles: Shop and Stars
The Shop is where purchases can be made. Ten offers consistently rotate every twenty hours: two Legendary petals, three Mythics, three Ultras, and two Supers.
Occasionally, there will be discounts on petals that decrease the overall price of the petal.
You can lock the current offer by clicking the Lock button at the top right of the shop menu.

The Hel Beetle is hard to defeat due to its fast movement speed, high HP, high body damage, and ability to teleport directly on top of you. Players should use petals that can slow down mobs, such as Web, Pincer, Heavy, and Mythic+ Jelly (not very advised to use Jelly as it has little knockback against Legendary+ Hel Beetles).

A squad is formed when a player goes near another player within a certain level range with the "Auto-join squads" setting enabled, invites them through the in-game chat, the /squad-invite command, or the Guilds UI, or gets invited by them. Said level range increases with the player's level and caps at 20. Squads are disabled in Hel and Rift.
A squad can have up to 4 players.

In the Crafting menu, click the petal to place five, or shift-click the petal to place all available petals into the slots. To proceed with crafting, click 'Craft' to attempt the creation process.

The Crafting menu can be accessed by clicking the Craft button. It is to the bottom left of the interface and can also be pulled up by pressing 'C' on the keyboard.
In the Crafting menu, the petals are listed in alphabetical order from top to bottom: one should have five or more of the same rarity and type of a petal in order to craft it.

Main article: Bugs and Glitches/Wall clipping
Wall Clipping is a glitch that allows players to enter into Walls in the map, usually entering through corners of intersections between walls. This allows the flower to clip through and enter the normally impenetrable walls.
To replicate this, the player aligns their flower at a wall with a 90º angle.

• This is a visual glitch and does not affect the player's petals or inventory.

Ankh is a petal in florr.io. Its function consists of allowing players to place the petal on the ground. However, once Ankh's HP reaches zero or it disappears by having its slot occupied by another petal, the player teleports to Ankh's place prior to the petal's disappearance. Ankh is dropped by Mummy Beetles, Nazar Beetles, Pharaoh Beetles and Tombs.

• Dahlias versus Jellyfish can go both ways: either Jellyfish damage you once, Dahlias heal you for a bit, then Jellyfish outdamage and kill you, or Dahlias hold just enough to outheal them (be sure to upgrade your Duplicator and/or Reload Talent trees for that). Its function consists of discharging lightning on the enemy closest to the player when he collides with (and takes the corresponding body damage from) a mob or an enemy flower, but not projectiles. To attempt this glitch, all these requirements have to be met:
• The sides of the wall must be completely straight (for example, the stone walls at Garden's spawn) and meet at a perfectly 90º angle.
• The player must go very, very, slowly into the wall. The faster you bubble into a corner, the less likely the clip will succeed.
• Be patient.

Shell: Neutral mob that chases in bursts once every 2 seconds when provoked and has low health.
